title: Pentagon to Work With USDA to Protect US Farmland | NTD
text:
The Department of War is teaming up with the Department of Agriculture to better protect America's farmland. War Secretary Pete Hegseth speaking alongside the Secretary of Agriculture this morning, highlighting the need to protect farmland from foreign adversaries.
